text:
Ravi Singh: Heads-up: last week's marketplace outage exposed ambiguity in partner escalation. We need a tiny, actionable SEV path for marketplace + SI partners.
Nina Kaur: Agreed. Minimal flow: partner reports -> partner-support triage -> if SEV-1/2 open shared channel -> Redwood oncall leads initial mitigation.
Tom Baker: Add thresholds: open shared channel if >3 affected customers OR publish failures blocking new listings. Otherwise ticket + DM.
Ravi Singh: Channel naming proposal: #p-<short>-sev-<yyww>-<n> so we can track by week. Keep partner read-only until elevated.
ops-bot: Template created: pinned runbook link, incident card, watchers @product @sre.
Partner Integrations: Handback rule request: Redwood owns up to 2 hours or until rollback. After that partner ops becomes lead if they can remediate; Redwood stays advisory.
Nina Kaur: Handback checklist: confirm partner remediation plan, route alerts to partner channel, create follow-up ticket (tag: partner-rca).
Tom Baker: Initial incident card to paste into channel: SEV / Impact / Start time / Services / Steps tried / Owner / Requested partner action. Keep it one message.
Ravi Singh: Action items: Nina to draft channel naming + decision thresholds (EOD). Tom to update incident card template (tomorrow). I'll coordinate a tabletop with top marketplace partners next month.
Nina Kaur: Will also add a weekly digest of active partner SEV channels for partnerships leads.
Ravi Singh: Thanks all. I'll post the draft later. :thumbsup:
